title: Dispenses too much dish soap squeezed from bottom.
text:
Dispenses too much dish soap squeezed from bottom.. When you just barely squeeze the sides in like 1/4th inch both sides, a little more than a teaspoon of dish soap comes out. The top dispenses a couple drops if you tap it lightly enough, but getting a feel for it is more hassle than it's worth. You may be better off just putting dish soap in a traditional hand soap dispenser to get a small amount without having to tip the dish liquid bottle just right.

I do think something like this would be very good for dispensing soap to bathe your dog though.
